description: This file defines a PHP class 'JSON' that provides static methods for JSON encoding and decoding, including handling special characters and deprecated methods. It includes licensing and project information related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for JSON encoding and decoding, with support for special character encoding and deprecated methods.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an array into a JSON string, with optional special character encoding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP variable, with optional envelope examination.

methods.name: encodeReal
methods.description: Deprecated method for encoding, now calls encode.

methods.name: decodeReal
methods.description: Deprecated method for decoding, now calls decode.
